maximum_archive_entries.description: Maximum normalized outer ZIP entries, counting files and directory entries including implied parent directories. Omitting a directory record cannot evade the limit. Nested archives count as files, not recursively expanded members. Null adds no project limit; platform safety limits always apply.
maximum_archive_entries.title: Maximum Archive Entries

maximum_archive_size_bytes.description: Maximum verified byte count of the entire submitted compressed ZIP, including archive metadata; not expanded contents or summed compressed member sizes. Null adds no project limit; platform safety limits always apply.
maximum_archive_size_bytes.title: Maximum Archive Size Bytes

maximum_file_size_bytes.description: Project-specific maximum expanded bytes per submitted file. Null adds no project limit; platform safety limits always apply.
maximum_file_size_bytes.title: Maximum File Size Bytes

maximum_package_size_bytes.description: Project-specific maximum total expanded bytes in the submitted ZIP, verified from actual contents; not compressed upload bytes. Null adds no project limit; platform safety limits always apply.
maximum_package_size_bytes.title: Maximum Package Size Bytes

required_artifacts.description: Exact canonical relative POSIX regular-file paths inside the submitted ZIP. Required directories belong in checker specifications, never this hash-required file list. A bare path such as task.toml requires that file at the ZIP root; wrapper/task.toml does not satisfy it. Nested paths such as outputs/answer.md require that exact location. No trailing separators, duplicate paths, traversal, storage references or secret files.
